summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting preliminary domestic Vietnam deliveries of 17,955 EVs in June 2026 and 115,916 deliveries in the first half of 2026, a 72% increase year-over-year. The filing provides model-specific delivery details, notes the introduction of the VF 2 model with pre-orders open and deliveries expected in September 2026. It is a routine operational update with no special-situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or capital return. The registrant is VinFast, reporting as a foreign private issuer.
